ai_language_tip: Speak clear, polite standard Bulgarian (bg, Cyrillic); Russian is understood by many older people but avoid it as a default; English works in Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna and Black Sea / ski resorts, much less in small towns and state offices.
english_ok: sometimes — Common in Sofia centre, resorts and international hotels and among younger staff; scarce at state clinics, municipal offices, village guesthouses and garages.
politeness: Formal 'Вие' with strangers; open with 'Добър ден' + who you are calling for ('обаждам се от името на...'); close with 'Благодаря, довиждане'. Tone is warm but direct.
name_tip: Surname first in bookings ('на името на Иванов'); Bulgarian surnames change by gender (Иванов / Иванова), so give the exact form; spell foreign names letter by letter in Latin and expect them to be written in Cyrillic.
phone_tip: Mobile 08x + 7 digits (e.g. 088 123 4567, 10 digits with 0), Sofia landline 02 + 7 digits; read in groups; Viber on the same mobile number is very common for confirmations.
time_tip: 24-hour clock is standard in writing ('19:30 ч.'); spoken 'седем и половина' = 7:30 (no German-style trap) and 'без петнайсет осем' = 7:45; always read back in 24h.
number_tip: Digits are usually read in groups of 2–3; 'две' vs 'двама/двете' change with gender and counting people ('двама души'); read prices clearly in euro (Bulgaria uses the euro since 2026; older people may still mention leva).
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch 12:00–13:30 at small offices and practices, restaurant peaks around 13:00 and 19:30–21:00, calls after 20:00, and Sundays for non-hospitality businesses.
closed_days: Most shops and malls open on Sunday (shorter hours); many state offices and private practices close weekends; long national holidays (3 March, Orthodox Easter which moves each year, 24 May, 6 and 22 September, Christmas/New Year) shut offices.
booking_channels: Superdoc.bg for private doctors and dentists; Booky.bg, Dineout.bg and Rezzo.bg for restaurants (mostly Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Bansko); Glovo and Wolt for delivery; phone and Viber/Facebook Messenger still dominant for salons, garages and small hotels.
voice_menu: Mobile operators (A1, Yettel, Vivacom), banks, utilities and the public health fund (НЗОК) use keypad IVR; small businesses answer directly, often on a personal mobile.
callback_habits: Small businesses often reply by Viber or call back from a mobile; platforms send SMS/email confirmation; many owners expect a short confirmation call the day before.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 滑雪學校、山屋、潛水與導覽多可電話預約；熱門景點與活動常走官網購票。

may_come_up.what: Standard tickets only online

sensitive_asked.what: Requires prepayment to a personal account

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 美髮、美甲與美容院普遍電話或 Instagram/Viber 預約，熟客常指定師傅；週末與節日前很滿。

may_come_up.what: Prepayment requested for long procedures
Cash only or card fee

sensitive_asked.what: Demands bank transfer deposit to a personal account

usually_asked: Hair length or removal of old gel

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消宜盡早；私人診所與美容院對臨時取消可能收費或要求預付，口頭確認即可。

may_come_up.what: Late cancellation fee or lost deposit

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks ЕГН to find the booking

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公立就醫須先有家庭醫師（личен лекар）並取得轉診單（направление）；私人診所與牙醫多可電話或 Superdoc 預約，自費價格通常事先告知。

may_come_up.what: No referral, so offers paid visit instead of НЗОК-covered
Directs to Superdoc online calendar

sensitive_asked.what: Asks ЕГН (personal number) or health-insurance status

usually_asked: НЗОК-covered with referral (направление) or paid (платен преглед)

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、電力自來水客服皆有語音選單，並依 GDPR 要求本人核身，代打通常無法處理帳戶事項。

may_come_up.what: Refuses third party without the account holder

sensitive_asked.what: Asks ЕГН, card details, client number or one-time codes

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市政辦事多走線上或臨櫃排隊，部分可電話預約；學校與幼兒園報名多為線上系統，電話可問流程。

may_come_up.what: Appointment or application only online

sensitive_asked.what: Asks ЕГН or child's birth certificate data

usually_asked: Child age and district for kindergarten

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 住宅多為公寓大樓，需告知區（ж.к.）、樓號（бл.）、入口（вх.）、樓層與門牌；水電工常以時段約定。

may_come_up.what: Callout fee plus hourly rate quoted
Asks whether building has a working lift for heavy items

usually_asked: Address with district, block, entrance, floor and flat (ж.к., бл., вх., ет., ап.)

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 家庭旅館（къща за гости）與小飯店習慣電話、Viber 與 Email 訂房，旺季常要求訂金；連鎖飯店多導向官網或訂房平台。

may_come_up.what: Tourist tax (туристически данък) charged per night
Deposit by bank transfer required to confirm

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card number or ID/passport number

usually_asked: Adults, children and room type (двойна стая, апартамент)

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間、可否刷卡、是否有貨、是否可帶寵物等通常電話直接回答；小店老闆常以手機接聽。

may_come_up.what: Kitchen closes earlier than the venue

usually_asked: The question (работно време, плащане с карта, наличност, домашни любимци)

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫診所與寵物美容可電話預約；出國旅遊需歐盟寵物護照（паспорт за домашен любимец）與疫苗紀錄。

may_come_up.what: Emergency or weekend visit costs more

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多透過 imot.bg 等網站與房仲，房仲常接電話安排看房；仲介費與押金規則需問清楚。

may_come_up.what: Agent asks to send listing number first

usually_asked: Household size, pets and move-in date

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車廠（автосервиз）、年度車檢（ГТП）、換胎季（春秋）可電話預約；家電與手機維修常先口頭估價。

may_come_up.what: Paid diagnostic if repair declined
Asks VIN from the registration certificate (талон) for parts

sensitive_asked.what: Demands prepayment to order a part

usually_asked: Car make, model, year and plate number
Work needed (ГТП, смяна на гуми, ремонт, диагностика)
Device model and fault for electronics

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 保加利亞晚餐多在 19:00～21:00，週末與夏季海濱、冬季滑雪勝地熱門餐廳建議預約；小餐館（механа）多接電話或 Viber 訂位。

may_come_up.what: Large groups or holidays need a set menu or deposit
Terrace (градина/тераса) tables seasonal or not reservable

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for card number or bank transfer to hold an ordinary table

usually_asked: Number of people and children (детско столче)
Inside or garden/terrace, smoking area in some venues
Occasion such as birthday or name day (имен ден)

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 藥局（аптека）、麵包店、蛋糕店與書店常可電話預留或預訂；節日（復活節、聖誕）蛋糕需提早數天訂。

may_come_up.what: Pharmacy orders item for next-day pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Requests upfront transfer for a custom cake

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 披薩、烤肉（скара）與速食店常接受電話訂餐自取或外送，現付為主；多數外送則走 Glovo/Wolt。

may_come_up.what: Cash only on pickup
Delivery only via Glovo or Wolt

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Econt（Еконт）與 Speedy 為主要快遞，追蹤多用網站或 App、客服有語音選單；可改用官網或 App 查詢、或到辦公室（офис）詢問。

may_come_up.what: Courier hotline handled by keypad IVR; suggests tracking online

sensitive_asked.what: Asks pickup code sent by SMS

transport.before_dialing_zh: 計程車行（такси）普遍可電話叫車，也常用 App；機場接送與包車可預約，費率依車行。

may_come_up.what: Dispatcher gives car number and arrival time
Fixed price for airport or intercity transfer

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks card or driving licence number
